fishing: WHEN: Wed Oct 21 NE winds easing, better later. PASSES-BEACH: redfish & flounder near passes on live shrimp/gold spoons. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper around docks/pier, redfish & small snook near mangroves/docks, trout on flats. NEARSHORE: limited by prior weather, mangrove snapper. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pinfish, cutbait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from/offshore SWFL (Sarasota in/offshore, Hillsborough offshore). Not present in Charlotte/Lee/Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, sample ~Oct 5). No advisory.
fpl: Charlotte/Sarasota small isolated outages only, no major Englewood impact.
